method: Instrumented laboratory builds: A exact 54663a0 sources; B current interface fixes with JS engine; C same fixes with Rust/Wasm. Instrumentation only in temporary copies. 10 repetitions per arm, rotating order, fresh contexts plus reload, same 100 history rows, touch/keyboard/PMT workload, HTTP uncompressed loopback. Ready sampled after layout and fonts; double RAF is a paint opportunity proxy. Engine includes JS/Rust boundary and state cloning; historyReducer excludes engine/format; serialization excludes storage; LCD includes actual drawing; layout includes DOM measurement. Event Timing filters action events and browser rounds to 8ms with 16ms threshold. RPC panel opening includes 260ms animation plus driver scheduling.
